content.text:
Finding submitted.

**LOL-CAP — deviation (fallback target).** Section 11.5 is the Agreement's only limitation-of-liability provision: a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages with carve-outs for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, Article 9/Section 5.8 breach and third-party indemnified damages. No aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere (Articles 6, 11, 12 and 13 checked; the only "limits" are the Section 11.6 insurance minima), so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited and the fallback is not met.

Cure: a single inserted Section 11.5.1 adding a mutual cap at twelve months' fees paid or payable by AbbVie, with indemnification, Article 9 confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap — all six fallback elements in one operation, with no preferred-level extras (USD 1m floor, data-protection/IP carve-outs, payment-obligations exclusion) volunteered.
